`latest` muammolari:
- Turli node'larda turli versiya ishlashi mumkin (biri eski cache'dan).
- `rollout undo` — oldingi ReplicaSet ham `latest` — hech narsa qaytmaydi.
- Qaysi commit prod'da ekanini bilib bo'lmaydi.
Tag'ni ustidan yozish (mutable tag) ham xuddi shunday xavfli — registry'da tag immutability yoqing.

33389.a:
```sh
kubectl cordon node-3
kubectl drain node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=10m
# ... kernel update, reboot ...
kubectl uncordon node-3
kubectl get nodes      # STATUS: Ready,SchedulingDisabled -> Ready
```
- DaemonSet pod'lari evict qilinmaydi — `--ignore-daemonsets` kerak.
- emptyDir ma'lumoti yo'qoladi — shuning uchun alohida flag bilan tasdiqlash.
- Drain osilsa: PDB ruxsat bermayapti (`replicas: 1` + `minAvailable: 1`) yoki controller'siz "yalang'och" pod.

33390.a:
```sh
k9s -n prod             # :pods, :deploy, l = logs, s = shell, d = describe, ctrl-d = delete
kubectl krew install ctx ns neat tree
kubectl ctx prod-eu; kubectl ns payments
kubectl tree deploy api              # Deployment -> ReplicaSet -> Pod
kubectl get pod x -o yaml | kubectl neat   # status/managedFields'siz toza YAML
stern -n prod api                    # ko'p pod loglari rangli, bir oqimda
```

Alias: `alias k=kubectl` + `source <(kubectl completion bash)` + `complete -F __start_kubectl k`.
Ehtiyot: UI'da prod context'da "delete" bir tugma — read-only kubeconfig ishlating.

```sh
ls /etc/kubernetes/manifests/
```

33394.a:
```
kubectl apply -> authn -> authz (RBAC) -> mutating admission -> schema validation
             -> validating admission -> etcd
```
Built-in misollar: `LimitRanger`, `ResourceQuota`, `PodSecurity`, `NamespaceLifecycle`.
Webhook xavfi: webhook servisi yiqilsa va `failurePolicy: Fail` bo'lsa — cluster'da pod yaratib bo'lmaydi (hatto webhook'ning o'zini tuzatish ham). Shuning uchun:
- `namespaceSelector` bilan `kube-system`ni chiqarib tashlash,
- `timeoutSeconds` qisqa, webhook HA (2+ replika, PDB),
- muhim bo'lmagan qoidalar uchun `failurePolicy: Ignore`.
K8s 1.30+: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL) — webhook'siz, cluster ichida.

33395.a:
```sh
kubectl get ns old-team -o jsonpath='{.spec.finalizers}{.metadata.finalizers}'
kubectl api-resources --verbs=list --namespaced -o name | \
  xargs -n1 kubectl get -n old-team --ignore-not-found --show-kind
# qolgan CR'lar, ularning controller'i (operator) allaqachon o'chirilgan
```
Sabablar: operator o'chirilgan, lekin uning CR'larida finalizer qolgan; APIService ishlamayapti (`kubectl get apiservice` — False).
To'g'ri yo'l: controller'ni qaytarib tozalashga imkon berish. Finalizer'ni qo'lda olib tashlash (`kubectl patch ... -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge`) — tashqi resurslar (LB, disk) yetim qolishi mumkin.
`--cascade=orphan` — egasini o'chirib, bolalarini qoldirish.

33396.a:
```yaml
spec:
  hostNetwork: true
  dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet
  dnsConfig:
    options: [{ name: ndots, value: "2" }]
```
Gotcha'lar:
- `hostNetwork` + `dnsPolicy` default -> pod cluster Service nomlarini topa olmaydi.
- hostNetwork pod'lar node portini band qiladi — bir node'da bitta replika.
- Xavfsizlik: node tarmog'iga to'liq kirish — Pod Security `baseline` uni taqiqlaydi.
- `ndots`ni pasaytirish tashqi domenlar uchun DNS so'rovlar sonini kamaytiradi.

33397.a:
```yaml
apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1
kind: PriorityClass
metadata: { name: business-critical }
value: 100000
globalDefault: false
preemptionPolicy: PreemptLowerPriority
description: "To'lov va checkout servislari"
---
spec:
  priorityClassName: business-critical
```
Ishlatish: muhim servislar > batch job'lar; overprovisioning (manfiy prioritetli "pause" pod'lar).
Xavf: hamma o'zini "critical" deb belgilasa ma'nosi yo'qoladi — ResourceQuota bilan PriorityClass bo'yicha cheklang. Preemption PDB'ni iloji boricha hurmat qiladi, lekin kafolat bermaydi.

```sh
git restore main.go               # o'zgarishni tashlash (eski: git checkout -- main.go)
git restore --staged main.go      # unstage (eski: git reset HEAD main.go)
git clean -n                      # nima o'chishini ko'rish (dry run)
git clean -fd                     # untracked fayl va kataloglar
git clean -fdx                    # + .gitignore'dagilar (build, node_modules, .env!)
```
`-x` ehtiyot: lokal `.env`, IDE sozlamalari ham o'chadi. Har doim avval `-n`.
Commit qilinmagan o'zgarishni `restore` qilsangiz — qaytarib bo'lmaydi (reflog'da yo'q).

```
1.4.2 -> 1.4.3   bug fix
1.4.3 -> 1.5.0   yangi endpoint, eski ishlaydi
1.5.0 -> 2.0.0   API'dan maydon olib tashlandi
```

| Constraint | Ma'nosi |
|---|---|
| `^1.4.0` (npm) | >=1.4.0 <2.0.0 |
| `~1.4.0` (npm) | >=1.4.0 <1.5.0 |
| `~> 5.60` (Terraform) | >=5.60, <6.0 |

Avtomatlashtirish: Conventional Commits (`feat:` -> minor, `fix:` -> patch, `feat!:`/`BREAKING CHANGE` -> major) + semantic-release/release-please -> tag va changelog.
Go modullari: v2+ import yo'lida `/v2` bo'lishi shart.

```sh
split -l 25 data.txt part_             # 25 qatordan: part_aa, part_ab
```


`StrictHostKeyChecking=no` — MITM'ga eshik ochadi; faqat vaqtinchalik lab'da. Avtomatlashtirishda: known_hosts'ni IaC orqali to'ldirish yoki SSH sertifikatlari (CA bilan imzolangan host key).

33415.a:
```sh
sudo useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
id app                       # uid=998(app) ... (system UID diapazoni)
sudo -u app /opt/app/bin/server    # shu user nomidan ishga tushirish
```

33416.a:
```yaml
# GitHub Actions
jobs:
  test:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        go: ["1.24", "1.25"]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
      with: { go-version: "${{ matrix.go }}", cache: true }   # go mod + build cache
    - run: go test -race ./...
```
Cache kaliti lock faylning hash'idan (`go.sum`, `package-lock.json`) — dependency o'zgarsa cache yangilanadi.
Docker: `cache-from/cache-to: type=gha` yoki registry cache.
Gotcha: cache'ga natija artefaktlarini (test natijasi) qo'ymang — "yashil" eskirgan build.

33417.a:
```
PR:      lint -> unit test -> SAST -> SCA -> secret scan -> build image -> image scan
          -> quality gate (yangi kodda: coverage >= 80%, 0 critical)
staging: deploy -> DAST (ZAP baseline) -> e2e
prod:    imzolangan image, admission policy
```
```sh
govulncheck ./...          # faqat haqiqatan chaqirilgan zaif funksiyalar
semgrep ci
trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig .
```
Amaliyot: "yangi kod" bo'yicha gate (eski qarzni birdaniga emas), false positive'larni boshqarish jarayoni, critical bo'lmaganlar — ticket, bloklamaydi. Aks holda jamoa skanerlarni o'chirib qo'yadi.
